description: Bitcasa upgrades your desktop computer, laptop, tablet, and mobile phone to infinite storage space. Simply move files to Bitcasa to free up space on all your devices, and "mirror" folders on your computer to Bitcasa for automatic and continuous backup. ALL of your photos, music, movies, and documents can be accessed instantly on your computer, phone, and tablet. Sharing your photo albums or videos with anyone you choose is simple. There are no rules or limitations with Bitcasa so you will never run out of storage space again. Everything is encrypted and always backed up so your data is safe...
